tasks.label: Publish release tag
tasks.command: bash -c 'set -e; TAG="${1}"; if ! git diff-index --quiet HEAD; then echo "Error: git status is not clean"; exit 1; fi; if git rev-parse "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: tag $TAG already exists. To delete locally and on origin: git tag -d $TAG && git push origin :$TAG"; exit 1; fi; git tag "$TAG" && git push origin "$TAG"' -- ${input:releaseTag}
